title: 30x30 Conserved areas, Terrestrial (2026)
description: The California Protected Areas Database (CPAD) contains data on lands owned in fee by governments, non-profits and some private entities that are protected for open space purposes. Data includes all such areas in California, from small urban parks to large national parks and forests, mostly aligned to assessor parcel boundaries. Data is collected by Holdings (parcels) which are aggregated to Units (commonly named areas within a county) and Super Units (commonly named areas generally).
snippet: CPAD is suitable for a wide range of planning, assessment, analysis and display purposes. CPAD should not be used as the basis for regulatory, legal or other specific governmental actions. Read the CPAD Data Disclaimer for more information. This layer is a combination of CPAD, CCED, PADUS, WSR, and ACEC to form California's Conservation Areas.
accessInformation: California Protected Areas Database (CPAD - www.calands.org). June 2026.
licenseInfo: All users must review the CPAD Data Disclaimer before using the dataset - CPAD is generally available to any user.
